summary: AI & Full-Stack Engineer with 2 years of hands-on experience shipping production computer-vision and web systems end to end from dataset labeling and model training to inference optimization, backend architecture, and the dashboards operators actually use. Delivered a real-time AI surveillance platform running 16 concurrent camera streams at 10 FPS on edge hardware, and full-stack products serving 100+ users. Focused on building end-to-end AI products where model quality and software engineering matter equally.

highlights: Own end-to-end development of GuardAI, an AI surveillance product deployed at 1 client sites covering dataset pipeline, model training, inference service, backend, and operator dashboard.
Built a real-time detection pipeline (YOLO + MediaPipe) reaching 0.80 mAP@0.5 and 10 FPS on rk3576s, supporting 16 concurrent camera streams per node.
Cut inference latency from 117 ms to 17 ms via INT8 quantization and RKNN export, lowering hardware cost per camera by 70%.
Designed the backend (Laravel, PostgreSQL, Redis) to ingest 1200 detection events/minute and push live alerts over WebSocket, keeping p95 dashboard latency under 250ms.
Integrated IoT actuators alarm for automated on-site warning, cutting operator response time from 45s to 8s.

highlights: Delivered an end-to-end POS for 3 outlets: QR-code ordering, kitchen display system, Midtrans payment integration, and sales analytics — processing 450 orders/day.
Reduced API p95 response time by 30% using Redis caching and an event-driven order pipeline.
Built real-time kitchen and cashier dashboards over WebSocket, cutting average order-to-kitchen time from 40s to 6s.

projects.description: An AI-assisted job platform featuring automated CV roasting, application tracking, CV management, and job-sharing.
highlights: Shipped an LLM-powered "CV Roasting" feature using the Gemini API with structured-output prompting, returning section-level resume feedback in under 10 seconds.
Built application tracking, CV management, and job-sharing features now used by 200 users, with 20 CVs analyzed to date.
Cut LLM cost per analysis by 50% through prompt compression and Redis-backed caching of repeated CV sections.
